label: Button
description: A single labeled button that performs one action on the page's record: fire a workflow transition, save pending edits, or open a quick-create form. Use it for the one or two most important actions in a card or column; group the rest in an action menu.
usage: Use a verb-first label ("Resolve", "Escalate to network").
Use tone primary for the single main action in a container and danger for destructive actions.
Add confirm for actions that are hard to undo (cancel, close).
Prefer action.transition_buttons for showing all available transitions.
constraints: transition:<id> must name a transition of the entity's workflow; it is hidden when not valid from the current state or the viewer may not fire it.
save submits pending edits; validation and data rules run on the server.
quick_create:<id> must name a form view (ViewSpec kind form); it is hidden when the viewer may not create that view's entity.
label is at most 40 characters; at most one primary button per card or column.

action.description: transition:<transition id>, save, or quick_create:<form view id>.

binding.description: Acts on the page's record; availability follows workflow state and permissions.

accessibility.keyboard: Enter or Space activates. While the action runs the button is aria-disabled and announces busy.
accessibility.notes: Icon-only rendering is not allowed; the label is always the accessible name. Confirmations use feedback.confirm_dialog.
